collection.title: Citroen C5 Hatchback 2003 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Citroen C5 Estate 2003 to 2008 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this C5 Hatchback, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
